title: Rooftop Hottub-7min to Broadway-14 beds-Pool Table
description:
Colorful group stays center on a private rooftop with a year-round hot tub, skyline view, fire table, gas grill, outdoor dining, lounge seating, hammock, and putting area. Indoors, a separate game room adds ping pong, a pool table, arcade games, and life-size games. The home also offers four bedrooms, four full bathrooms, an open living and dining area, a full kitchen, laundry, a workspace, and parking for two vehicles.

The space
The home has four bedrooms and four full bathrooms. The listed sleeping arrangements are a king bed in Bedroom 1; two bunk beds in Bedroom 2; a double bed and one bunk bed in Bedroom 3; and two bunk beds in Bedroom 4. The open living and dining area includes comfortable seating, a TV, and a fireplace, while the full kitchen supports group meals. A separate game room includes ping pong, a pool table, arcade games, a projector screen, and additional play space. The private rooftop includes a hot tub, skyline view, fire table, gas grill, outdoor dining, lounge seating, hammock, putting area, turf, and string lights.

Guest access
Your reservation includes private use of the entire home, including all four bedrooms and bathrooms, the living room, kitchen, balcony, laundry area, game room, and rooftop. Two on-site parking spaces are available. Self check-in uses a keypad, and luggage drop-off is allowed.

Other things to note
Check-in is after 4:00 PM, checkout is before 10:00 AM, and pets are not allowed. Exterior security cameras and noise-monitoring devices are present. Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms are listed.

The house is just 4 miles/ 10 minutes drive from Downtown Nashville. Nearby attractions 📍

This part of Nashville is commonly marketed as a convenient base for exploring Downtown, Lower Broadway, East Nashville, and Germantown. Visit Music City describes 

East Nashville as a popular area for innovative restaurants, dive bars, creative cocktails, live music, art, and vintage shopping, while Germantown is known for its walkable feel, brunch spots, bars, acclaimed restaurants, the Farmers’ Market, and museums. Lower Broadway remains the heart of Downtown’s live-music scene.

Lower Broadway 🎶 – Nashville’s famous live music strip and nightlife hub.
East Nashville 🍸 – great for food, drinks, local shops, and live-music energy.
Germantown 🍽️ – walkable, polished, and packed with restaurants and brunch spots.
Ryman Auditorium 🎤 – one of Nashville’s most iconic live-performance venues.
Nissan Stadium 🏟️ – a major Nashville venue for sports, concerts, and events.
Nearby restaurants 🍽️

The Pharmacy Burger Parlor & Beer Garden 🍔🍺 – a well-known East Nashville burger and beer spot.
Butcher & Bee 🥗 – stylish East Nashville dining with seasonal, vegetable-forward, Middle Eastern-leaning plates.
Redheaded Stranger 🌮 – East Nashville taco favorite known for tacos, brisket, Hatch green chiles, and Tex-Mex flavors.
Five Points Pizza 🍕 – popular for New York-style pizza in East Nashville.
Monell’s 🍗 – a classic Germantown option for family-style Southern food.
